mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "List" scrapes epms.ppra.gov.pk's public tender listing (active or historical/closed, latest or filtered). "Detail" fetches the full detail page (organization contact, financial terms, workflow) for specific tender numbers.

listingType.title: Listing type (mode=list only)
listingType.description: "Active" is currently open/published tenders. "History" includes closed tenders too.

keyword.title: Keyword (mode=list only)
keyword.description: Free-text keyword matched against the tender's title, description, or tender number. Leave blank together with the other filters below to get the latest tenders instead of a filtered search.

tenderNoFilter.title: Tender number filter (mode=list only)
tenderNoFilter.description: Restrict the listing search to a specific PPRA tender number, e.g. TS0000012236E.

tenderNature.title: Tender nature (mode=list only)
tenderNature.description: Restrict to local or international tenders.

organizationId.title: Organization ID (mode=list only, advanced)
organizationId.description: PPRA's internal numeric ID for a specific procuring office (there are 500+, not enumerable here) -- find one from a previous run's organizationName field cross-referenced on epms.ppra.gov.pk's own filter dropdown, or leave blank.

countryId.title: Country ID (mode=list only, advanced)
countryId.description: PPRA's internal numeric ID for a country (relevant mostly to international tenders) -- leave blank unless you already know the ID.

advertiseDateFrom.title: Advertised from (mode=list only)
advertiseDateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only tenders advertised on or after this date.

advertiseDateTo.title: Advertised to (mode=list only)
advertiseDateTo.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only tenders advertised on or before this date.

closingDate.title: Closing date (mode=list only)
closingDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only tenders closing on this exact date.

startPage.title: Start page (mode=list only)
startPage.description: Which page of results to start collecting from (50 rows/page). Leave at 1 unless resuming a specific offset.

maxResults.title: Max results (mode=list only)
maxResults.description: Caps how many rows this run collects, paging forward automatically (50 rows/page) until this cap, the last page, or an empty page is reached.

tenderNo.title: Tender number or URL (mode=detail only)
tenderNo.description: A single PPRA tender number (e.g. TS0000012236E), or its full detail URL. Find these from a 'list' mode run's tenderNo/detailUrl fields.

tenderNos.title: Tender numbers or URLs (mode=detail only)
tenderNos.description: Multiple tender numbers (or full detail URLs) to fetch full detail for in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (mode=detail only)
maxConcurrency.description: How many tender detail pages to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. This target has no anti-bot gate, so a plain datacenter proxy (or no proxy) also works -- residential is offered for consistency with other actors in this collection.
